title: Function card
responsibility: Legacy nonvisual card entry delegating helpers, services and models to ExplorerModuleCard.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The helper, service or model at the viewed revision, including its recorded name and consumer links.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation that retains branch and commit when opening the helper, service or consumer.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.lens
inputs.description: Revision-scoped screenshot evidence for linked consumers.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: One shared module card with the helper invocation or entity name and at most three flat Used In links.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Function-card argument examples cannot serialize BigInt or circular values.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Serializing a deeply nested function argument example can exceed the runtime stack.

errors.name: Example serialization callback error
errors.description: A getter, proxy or toJSON method on an example value can throw while its invocation is serialized.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: An error from the address callback propagates while rendering the card or a consumer link.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: An error from the navigation callback propagates when a card or consumer link is activated.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: An error from the source-opening callback propagates when a consumer's source button is activated.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: An evidence callback error propagates when the shared card resolves a visual image or consumer preview.
